Olena V.: FYI I created a focused migration recipe for moving tenants from shared->reserved pools with step-by-step CLI/SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4312 :memo:
Ben C.: Nice. Can you include one explicit sentence that isolation_preference is advisory and placement can still be overridden by priority and capacity? Customers ask this a lot.
Olena V.: Added that line. Also included a compact Python + Terraform snippet. Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.capacity.create(tenant_id="acme", reserved_pool="reserved-gold", autoscale={"target_rps":100}, isolation_preference="reserved")
```
Harpreet K.: Please add the 15m quiet/promotion window recommendation and a mirror-traffic suggestion (start at 5%).
Olena V.: Done  added quiet window, mirror 5% for 1-2h, then promote. Also a one-liner showing how to attach a scale policy to reserved pool to avoid starvation (Terraform).
eng-platform: Recommend including a short rollback checklist and a note about quantized-model cold-starts (200-400ms on some older GPUs). Also suggest clients implement simple stream reconnect/backoff.
Olena V.: Added rollback steps and a tiny JS streaming-reconnect example. Also added suggested SLA sentence for legal to reuse: "Preemptible pools are excluded from the standard 99th percentile latency SLA; reserved pools should be used for SLA-backed latency guarantees."
